entries.source: Tobias Fritz, A synthetic approach to Markov kernels, conditional independence and theorems on sufficient statistics, arXiv:1908.07021v8
entries.actually_read: Example2.5: row-stochastic finite matrices, equation2.8, function inclusion and equation2.9; Example8.2: semiring matrices and normalization
entries.mechanism: Finite stochastic composition is matrix multiplication; deterministic functions map to Dirac matrices
entries.use: N1-A/N1-C and N2; prove sequential laws from primitive scalar assumptions rather than assume matrix laws
entries.adaptation: The generic proof needs only a unital semiring for normalized matrix composition; positivity conditions are separated for support transport. No tensor theorem is needed for the registered atom.
entries.boundary: General nonnegative rational/real algebra-law instantiation is paper-only. The concrete seven-arrow rational category is a separate executable kernel witness. No general measurable-kernel result is claimed.

entries.actually_read: Examples2.6 and3.3: finite multivalued maps, existential relation composition and the nonempty powerset construction; Example8.1 distinguishes all relations
entries.mechanism: A total relation assigns at least one possible target to each source; existential sequential composition preserves totality
entries.use: N1-B; arbitrary-type relational proof specializes to the finite executable model
entries.adaptation: Direct logical witnesses establish identity/associativity/closure without choosing a simultaneous selector
entries.boundary: Dead-end relations belong to a larger relation category. Possibility alone supplies no probabilities or event frequencies.

entries.actually_read: Examples10.3-10.4: finite deterministic kernels are functions, while unrestricted measurable-space analogues need additional hypotheses
entries.mechanism: Finite Dirac inclusion identifies ordinary functions with deterministic stochastic kernels
entries.use: N1-C; faithful finite deterministic inclusion and singleton relation inclusion
entries.adaptation: The generic nonnegative-weight interface admits Boolean weights, so exactly-one-support characterizes Dirac rows; normalized {0,1}-valued rows characterize functions only in the ordinary rational/real specialization
entries.boundary: Faithfulness is proved for the registered finite matrix setting, not promoted to arbitrary measurable spaces.

entries.source: Classical semiring-to-Boolean support connection applied to Fritz Examples2.5-2.6 and8.2
entries.actually_read: The matrix multiplication and existential relational composition definitions in Examples2.5-2.6, and Boolean-semiring relation interpretation in Example8.2
entries.mechanism: Zero-sum-free addition and no zero divisors make nonzero support preserve finite sums and products
entries.use: N1-D; derive finite-sum positivity/support, totality and functorial support from primitive facts
entries.adaptation: An explicit elementary proof supplies the bridge; the paper is not represented as stating our exact local theorem or counterexamples
entries.boundary: Signed cancellation and zero divisors invalidate support composition. Support equality does not determine event probabilities.

entries.boundary: No unseen empirical prediction, no novelty attribution, and no claim excluding every possible functorial section. The dimension0/1/2 input grid is not closed under composition.
